post.description: Read-only. statusCounts covers the full result before status filtering. Send {} on page load: omitted/null/empty filters mean all, with 12 days. Use marketSelections with divisionId and marketCode to select exact branches. Each scheduled rep contributes capacity once. Without products, openings are shared capacity. With products, openings are the maximum jointly feasible additional appointments of any selected applicable products, retaining all existing bookings and qualified rearrangements. This is not a sum of independent product counts or a guarantee of any particular mix. Explicit product codes are matched exactly; omit productCodes or send an empty list for no product filter. All matching markets are returned

500.description: Invalid stored counts/configuration or unexpected failure

503.description: Database temporarily unavailable; no availability fabricated

get.summary: Get users, division options, roles and access history
get.description: Returns all users and the 20 newest history records. ALL includes future active divisions. No authentication or administrator-role check in this phase.

500.description: Invalid stored data or unexpected failure

post.summary: Save one user's role, division selection, or both
post.description: Last-write-wins for submitted fields. Omitted role or division fields remain unchanged. Role and division selection can be updated together atomically in one request. Supply divisionScope and full divisionIds together; ALL uses an empty list. ACCESS_ADMIN requires ALL. Protects the last enabled administrator. Required X-User-Name is captured at save time. Unsupported fields return 400. No-op saves leave timestamps and history unchanged. Caller authorization is deferred.

post.summary: Insert a user with default READ_ONLY/ALL access
post.description: Uses the same atomic default insert as first-login provisioning. Requires a verified Entra Object ID; no directory lookup, authentication or caller-role check. Existing users return 409 without changes. Required X-User-Name is captured in audit.

get.summary: Get division, market and product filters
get.description: Products use canonical catalog names and active source mappings in active divisions, independently of slot data. Multiple source mappings are deduplicated. Only stored canonical products are returned. Mappings do not imply market eligibility.

get.summary: Get product-specific openings for one date
get.description: Maximum additional whole appointments that fit simultaneously on qualified scheduled reps. leadId excludes only that lead's current booking; no LP assignments are changed.
